content.value_statement: Designing consistent slides and documents takes time and requires visual choices. Theme Factory provides ready-made palettes and font pairings that Claude can apply to artifacts.
actual_capabilities: Shows a PDF showcase of ten available visual themes.
Guides users to choose a theme before applying styles.
Applies selected colors and fonts to slides, documents, reports, or HTML artifacts.
Uses theme files that define color palettes, typography, and visual identity.
Creates a custom theme when none of the preset options fit the artifact.
Checks contrast and readability while applying the chosen style.
limitations: Requires the user to confirm a theme before styling begins.
Depends on the artifact format and available editing tools in the current environment.
Does not replace brand guidelines or legal review for official materials.
The bundled PDF showcase needs manual inspection before marketplace publication.

use_cases.title: Refresh a presentation deck
use_cases.description: Apply a cohesive color palette and font pairing to an existing slide deck.

use_cases.title: Style client-facing reports
use_cases.description: Give a document or report a consistent visual identity before sharing it.

use_cases.title: Create a custom visual direction
use_cases.description: Generate a new theme from a short description when preset themes do not fit.

prompt_templates.title: Choose a preset theme
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner request for theme selection help.
prompt_templates.prompt: Show me the available Theme Factory options and help me choose one for this slide deck.

prompt_templates.title: Apply a selected theme
prompt_templates.scenario: User already knows which style they want.
prompt_templates.prompt: Apply the Ocean Depths theme to this artifact. Keep the content unchanged and improve visual consistency.

prompt_templates.title: Match an audience and tone
prompt_templates.scenario: User wants design guidance for a specific context.
prompt_templates.prompt: Recommend a Theme Factory theme for an executive strategy report, explain the choice, then apply it after I confirm.

prompt_templates.title: Generate a custom theme
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced request for a new theme direction.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a custom theme for a clean healthcare analytics presentation, show the palette and font choices, then wait for my approval before applying it.

output_examples.input: Apply a professional theme to my quarterly review deck.
output_examples.output: Claude shows the theme showcase, asks for a preferred theme, then updates the deck with coordinated colors and fonts.

output_examples.input: None of the preset themes match my brand.
output_examples.output: Claude proposes a custom theme with a descriptive name, palette, and typography, then asks for review before styling the artifact.

output_examples.input: Make this HTML landing page feel more modern.
output_examples.output: Claude recommends a suitable preset such as Tech Innovation or Modern Minimalist and applies the confirmed style consistently.

best_practices: Review the theme showcase before choosing a style.
Provide the target audience and desired tone for better recommendations.
Check the final artifact for contrast, readability, and brand alignment.
anti_patterns: Do not apply a theme before the user confirms the choice.
Do not mix multiple preset themes in one artifact without a clear reason.
Do not change the meaning or structure of the content while styling it.

faq.question: What does Theme Factory do?
faq.answer: It helps Claude apply professional color palettes and font pairings to artifacts such as slides, documents, reports, and HTML pages.

faq.question: How many preset themes are included?
faq.answer: The skill includes ten preset themes, each with a distinct palette, typography, and visual identity.

faq.question: Can it create a custom theme?
faq.answer: Yes. It can create a new theme from a short description when the preset options do not fit.

faq.question: Does it edit the theme showcase PDF?
faq.answer: No. The instructions say to show the PDF for viewing only and not modify it.

faq.question: Can it work on HTML artifacts?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill describes support for HTML landing pages as well as slides, documents, and reports.

faq.question: Is this a full brand system tool?
faq.answer: No. It provides practical themes for artifacts, but it does not replace formal brand guidelines.
